146391.overview: In Letter Zap! four players simultaneously have a grid of letters in which the goal is to find as many words as possible. In order to make a word the letters must the touching, and any letter can only be used once in a single word. The game plays almost identically to Boggle.

146392.overview: Lock 5 is a strategy game, developed and published by ZAPiT Games, which was released in 2006.
